title: Annual Sports Day 2026
description: Annual inter-school sports competition featuring athletics, football, cricket, badminton, and other sports. Open to all classes. Winners will receive medals and certificates. Special guest: Olympic athlete Mr. Shahidul Islam.

title: Science Fair 2026
description: Students will showcase innovative science projects in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Environmental Science. Judges from local universities will evaluate projects. Winners get district-level participation and prizes worth 50,000 Tk.

title: Victory Day Celebration
description: Cultural performances including patriotic songs, dances, drama and poetry recitation celebrating Bangladesh's Victory Day. Special documentary screening on Liberation War. Guest speaker: Freedom Fighter Mr. Abdul Kader.

title: Independence Day Program
description: Flag hoisting ceremony followed by cultural program. Students will perform patriotic songs and plays. Special assembly on the history of Bangladesh's independence. All students must wear national flag badges.

title: Bengali New Year (Pohela Boishakh) Celebration
description: Traditional Bengali New Year celebration with cultural programs, traditional games, and Boishakhi food festival. Students encouraged to wear traditional Bengali attire. Mangal Shobhajatra procession at 10 AM.

title: Annual Prize Distribution Ceremony
description: Award ceremony to honor top academic performers, sports champions, and students with exemplary conduct. Chief Guest: District Education Officer. Parents and guardians invited to attend.

title: Inter-School Debate Competition
description: Hosting debate competition with 12 schools participating. Topic: 'Technology: Blessing or Curse for Modern Education'. Finals will be judged by university professors. Prizes and certificates for winners.

title: Blood Donation Camp
description: Blood donation camp in collaboration with Dhaka Medical College Hospital. Open to students (18+), teachers, and staff. Free health checkup, refreshments, and certificate for all donors.

title: Study Tour to Cox's Bazar
description: 3-day educational tour for Class 9 & 10 students. Visit to marine drive, Himchari, Inani Beach, and marine aquarium. Educational sessions on marine life and coastal ecology. Cost: 8,000 Tk per student.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting
description: Quarterly parent-teacher meeting to discuss student progress, academic performance, attendance, and behavior. Individual consultations with subject teachers available. Report cards will be distributed.

title: Art & Craft Exhibition
description: Display of student artworks including paintings, sculptures, crafts, and digital art. Open to all students. Best artworks will be selected for permanent display in school gallery. Prizes for top 3 entries.

title: Math Olympiad Preparation Workshop
description: Intensive 5-day workshop for students interested in Math Olympiad. Expert trainers from Dhaka University will conduct sessions on problem-solving techniques. Free for all students.
